text:
Predicates:
GainsKnowledge(x) ::: x gains knowledge.
Smarter(x) ::: x is smarter.
Reads(x, y) ::: x reads y.
Book(y) ::: y is a book.
Author(y, z) ::: y is authored by z.
Premises:
∃x (Reads(x, y) ∧ Book(y)) ::: Harry read the book 'Walden' by Henry Thoreau.
∀x (GainsKnowledge(x) → Smarter(x)) ::: If a person gains knowledge, then they become smarter.
Conclusion:
GainsKnowledge(Harry) ::: Harry gains knowledge.
Smarter(Harry) ::: Harry is smarter.
